tours.trigger_label: New to this? Take a quick tour
tours.sa_step_intro_desc: A Super Agent runs a logistics hub — you receive parcels from sellers or walk-in customers, ship them to other cities, and earn from every shipping fee you collect.
tours.sa_step_hub_desc: Everything starts here in Pokea (Receive) — sellers hand off parcels, or a customer walks in and pays you directly.
tours.sa_step_receive_desc: Tap Walk-In to register a parcel for a customer paying you in person right now. Every parcel gets a tracking number automatically.
tours.sa_step_prepare_desc: Once a parcel is at your hub, Tuma (Dispatch) is where you send it onward — record the bus or courier company and ticket number.
tours.sa_step_handover_desc: When you dispatch a parcel, you record who's physically carrying it — a bus, courier, or a partner Super Agent's hub in another city.
tours.sa_step_tracking_desc: Historia shows every parcel's full journey. Buyers get SMS updates automatically at each step, so you rarely need to explain where their parcel is.
tours.sa_step_earnings_desc: Mapato shows exactly what you've earned. You keep 100% of the shipping fee you collect — your first 50 orders carry no platform fee.
tours.sa_step_cta_title: Ready? Let's create your first parcel
tours.sa_step_cta_destination_desc: Start by choosing where this parcel is going.
tours.sa_step_cta_submit_desc: Fill in the sender and recipient details above, then tap here to register your first parcel.

how_it_works.buyer_step1_desc: Search products from verified stores or browse classified ads across Tanzania. Filter by category, location or price.
how_it_works.buyer_step2_desc: Add products to your cart. All prices include delivery — no hidden charges. You see exactly what you pay.
how_it_works.buyer_step3_desc: Enter your delivery address and phone number. You can also order as a gift for someone else.
how_it_works.buyer_step4_desc: Pay via M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa or visit a KenteXa Agent near you to pay cash with your invoice number.
how_it_works.buyer_step5_desc: Your parcel gets a tracking number (e.g. KTX-ORD-1042). Track it in real-time from pickup to your door.
how_it_works.buyer_step6_desc: When you receive your order, confirm it. Payment is then released to the seller. If there's a problem, raise a dispute within 7 days.
how_it_works.seller_step1_desc: Register on KenteXa and apply to become a seller. Your store is reviewed and approved within 24 hours.
how_it_works.seller_step2_desc: Add products with photos, descriptions, specs and features. Set your price — delivery fee is included automatically.
how_it_works.seller_step3_desc: Get notified when a buyer places an order. Review the order details including delivery address and quantity.
how_it_works.seller_step4_desc: Hand your parcel to a KenteXa Super Agent near you (choose one on the map when shipping) or ship directly with your own courier. The first 50 manual shipments are free of KenteXa's handling fee — a small flat fee applies after that.
how_it_works.seller_step5_desc: For classified ads, create invoices for buyers so they can pay online or via agent. Track all your invoices in one place.
how_it_works.seller_step6_desc: Once the buyer confirms receipt, your payment (minus KenteXa's small commission) is released to your account.
how_it_works.agent_step1_desc: Register and apply to become a KenteXa payment agent. Get approved with your NIDA ID and location details.
how_it_works.agent_step2_desc: Your location is listed on KenteXa. Buyers near you can find you to pay cash for their orders.
how_it_works.agent_step3_desc: Buyers bring their invoice number. Enter it in your Agent Dashboard to see the order details and amount due.
how_it_works.agent_step4_desc: Collect cash from the buyer and process the payment via M-Pesa or your registered mobile money account.
how_it_works.agent_step5_desc: Confirm the payment in your dashboard. The buyer gets a receipt and the seller is notified.
how_it_works.agent_step6_desc: Earn 2.5%-5% commission on every payment you process. Track your earnings in real-time on your dashboard.
how_it_works.super_agent_step1_desc: Super Agents are logistics hubs that receive, batch and dispatch parcels for their city. Apply with your business details and real office address — buyers need to be able to find you.
how_it_works.super_agent_step2_desc: Receive parcels handed over by sellers, or create a walk-in counter order directly for a customer paying you in person. Every parcel gets a tracking number automatically (e.g. KTX-ORD-1042).
how_it_works.super_agent_step3_desc: Group several parcels heading to the same city into one Shehena batch. Each buyer gets an SMS the moment their parcel is added — the receiving hub gets one summary SMS when you dispatch, not one per parcel.
how_it_works.super_agent_step4_desc: Send the batch or parcel out — record the bus/courier company and ticket number. Update the status at each step — dispatched, in transit, arrived at destination.
how_it_works.super_agent_step5_desc: Use Hamisha to hand a parcel to a partner Super Agent's hub in another city, or let the buyer pick it up directly or request local delivery. The receiving hub and the buyer are both notified automatically.
how_it_works.super_agent_step6_desc: You keep 100% of the shipping fee you collect — KenteXa doesn't take a cut. Your first 50 orders carry no platform fee; after that, a flat TZS 1,000 fee per order applies. Track everything in your dashboard.
how_it_works.hero_desc: KenteXa connects buyers, sellers, payment agents and delivery agents in one trusted ecosystem.
how_it_works.commission_desc: Commission is only charged on the product price — delivery fees go fully to the seller.
how_it_works.protection_point1: Your payment is held in escrow — the seller only gets paid after you confirm receipt
how_it_works.protection_point2: Raise a dispute within 7 days if you receive a wrong or damaged item
how_it_works.protection_point3: Full refund if your order is never delivered
how_it_works.protection_point4: Verified sellers only — all stores are reviewed before approval
how_it_works.protection_point5: Real-time tracking so you always know where your parcel is
how_it_works.cta_desc: Join thousands of Tanzanians already buying and selling on KenteXa.

terms_and_conditions.intro_banner: 📋 Please read these terms carefully before using KenteXa. By creating an account or placing an order, you agree to these terms.
terms_and_conditions.section1_content:
By accessing or using KenteXa ("the Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

These terms apply to all users including buyers, sellers, payment agents, super agents and visitors.
terms_and_conditions.section2_content:
You must be at least 18 years old to use KenteXa. By registering, you confirm that:
- You are legally capable of entering into binding contracts
- You will provide accurate and truthful information
- You are a resident of Tanzania or conducting business in Tanzania
terms_and_conditions.section3_content:
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You agree to:
- Provide accurate registration information
- Notify us immediately of any unauthorized account access
- Not share your account with others
- Not create multiple accounts for fraudulent purposes

KenteXa reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.
terms_and_conditions.section4_content:
As a buyer on KenteXa, you agree to:
- Pay for orders you place using valid payment methods
- Provide accurate delivery addresses and contact information
- Confirm receipt of goods honestly — false confirmation to fraudulently release escrow funds is prohibited
- Raise disputes within 7 days of delivery if there is a genuine issue
- Not attempt to reverse payments after confirming receipt
terms_and_conditions.section5_content:
As a seller on KenteXa, you agree to:
- List only genuine products with accurate descriptions and photos
- Not sell counterfeit, illegal, prohibited or dangerous goods
- Fulfill orders within the stated timeframe
- Ship products in good condition matching the listing
- Respond to buyer disputes honestly and promptly
- Accept KenteXa's commission deduction from each sale

KenteXa reserves the right to remove any listing that violates these terms.
terms_and_conditions.section6_content:
The following items are strictly prohibited on KenteXa:
- Counterfeit or replica goods
- Illegal weapons, drugs or controlled substances
- Stolen goods
- Adult content or pornographic material
- Products that infringe intellectual property rights
- Goods prohibited by Tanzanian law

Violation will result in immediate account termination and may be reported to relevant authorities.
terms_and_conditions.section7_content:
KenteXa uses an escrow system to protect both buyers and sellers:
- Buyer's payment is held securely by KenteXa
- Payment is released to the seller only after the buyer confirms receipt
- If no confirmation is made within 14 days of delivery, funds are auto-released to the seller
- Disputes freeze the escrow until resolved by KenteXa's team

KenteXa is not a bank and does not hold funds beyond the transaction period.
terms_and_conditions.section8_content:
KenteXa charges sellers a commission on each completed sale:
- Commission rates range from 5% to 12% depending on product category
- Commission is applied to the product base price only — not the delivery fee
- Delivery fees are paid in full to the seller/super agent
- Agent commission is 2.5%-5% on each payment processed
- There are no listing fees — you only pay when you sell
terms_and_conditions.section9_content:
KenteXa operates a Super Agent delivery network across Tanzania:
- Sellers are responsible for handing parcels to a Super Agent hub
- Super Agents generate tracking numbers and dispatch parcels
- KenteXa is not liable for delays caused by force majeure, weather or third-party couriers
- Buyers should inspect parcels before confirming receipt
- Lost or damaged parcels must be reported within 48 hours of the expected delivery date
terms_and_conditions.section10_content:
If you have a dispute:
- Raise a dispute within 7 days of delivery via the Order page
- Provide clear evidence (photos, descriptions) of the issue
- KenteXa's team will review the dispute within 3-5 business days
- Decisions are final and binding on both parties
- Refunds are processed within 7 business days of a dispute resolution in the buyer's favour
terms_and_conditions.section11_content:
KenteXa collects personal data including name, phone number, email and location for the purpose of facilitating transactions. We:
- Do not sell your personal data to third parties
- Use data only for platform operations, order fulfillment and communication
- Store data securely in compliance with applicable Tanzanian laws
- May share data with payment processors and delivery agents as required

For full details, see our Privacy Policy.
terms_and_conditions.section12_content:
KenteXa is a marketplace platform and is not the buyer or seller in any transaction. We are not liable for:
- The quality, safety or legality of listed items
- Losses arising from buyer-seller disputes
- Payment failures caused by mobile network issues
- Delays in delivery by third-party couriers

Our maximum liability in any case is limited to the transaction value of the disputed order.
terms_and_conditions.section13_content: KenteXa may update these terms at any time. We will notify users of significant changes via email or platform notification. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
terms_and_conditions.section14_content: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Republic of Tanzania. Any disputes arising from these terms shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Tanzanian courts.

contact_us.faq1_a: KenteXa is a Tanzanian online marketplace that lets you buy and sell products safely. We use a secure escrow payment system where your money stays safe until you confirm you've received your product.
contact_us.faq2_q: How do I become a seller on KenteXa?
contact_us.faq2_a: Tap the ➕ button on the navbar and select "Open Your Store". Fill in your business details and you can start listing products immediately — no fees to apply.
contact_us.faq3_a: We accept M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa, and cash payments through our agents (KenteXa Agents) near you.
contact_us.faq4_a: Delivery time depends on the shipping method and distance. Via KenteXa Super Agent network, most deliveries within the same region take 1-3 days. Cross-region deliveries typically take 3-7 days.
contact_us.faq5_q: Is my money safe when I buy something?
contact_us.faq5_a: Yes. Your money stays in our escrow account until you confirm you've received your product in good condition. The seller isn't paid until you confirm.
contact_us.faq6_q: How do I become a KenteXa Agent?
contact_us.faq6_a: Tap the ➕ button and select "Become an Agent". You'll earn 2.5%-5% commission processing payments for customers near you.
contact_us.faq7_q: What do I do if I have a problem with my order?
contact_us.faq7_a: You can raise a dispute on the "My Orders" page within 24 hours of receiving the product. Our team will handle it within 24 hours.

about_us.team1_desc: Visionary behind KenteXa — building Tanzania's digital commerce future.
about_us.team2_desc: Building and maintaining the platform infrastructure.
about_us.team3_desc: Ensuring every buyer and seller has a great experience.
about_us.milestone1: KenteXa idea conceived — solving Tanzania's fragmented marketplace problem
about_us.milestone2: Platform development begins under Bishoo Intelligence Systems (BiS)
about_us.milestone3: KenteXa launches publicly — connecting buyers, sellers and agents nationwide
about_us.value1_desc: Every transaction is protected. Buyers pay securely, sellers receive verified payments.
about_us.value2_desc: Built for Tanzanian people — supporting M-Pesa, Airtel, Tigo and local agent networks.
about_us.value3_desc: We empower small businesses, individual sellers and local agents to earn and grow.
about_us.value4_desc: Continuous improvement — from AI-powered search to real-time parcel tracking.
about_us.value5_desc: Clear fees, honest policies, no hidden charges for buyers or sellers.
about_us.value6_desc: Our Super Agent network ensures your parcel reaches you anywhere in Tanzania.
about_us.hero_desc: KenteXa is a secure digital marketplace built for Tanzania — empowering buyers, sellers, and agents to trade with confidence across all 21 regions.
about_us.mission_desc: To democratize commerce in Tanzania by building a trusted digital marketplace where anyone — from a mama ntilie in Mwanza to a tech seller in Dar es Salaam — can buy and sell safely, pay easily, and receive goods reliably anywhere in the country.
about_us.story_p1: KenteXa was born from a simple observation — Tanzania has millions of talented sellers, creative entrepreneurs, and hardworking small business owners, but no single trusted platform where they could reach customers safely across the entire country.
about_us.story_p2: Traditional online marketplaces lacked mobile money integration, local delivery networks, and the trust mechanisms needed for Tanzanian commerce. Buyers feared being scammed. Sellers struggled to get paid. Parcels got lost with no tracking.
about_us.story_p3: KenteXa solves all of this — with built-in escrow protection, a nationwide Super Agent delivery network, mobile money payments (M-Pesa, Airtel, Tigo), real-time parcel tracking, and a community of verified sellers. Built by Tanzanians, for Tanzania.
about_us.contact_desc: Have questions, feedback or partnership inquiries? We'd love to hear from you.

privacy_policy.page_subtitle: Last updated: June 2026 · We respect your privacy
privacy_policy.intro_banner: 🔒 Your privacy matters to us. KenteXa does not sell your personal data. We collect only what is necessary to operate the marketplace safely.
privacy_policy.section1_content:
We collect the following information when you use KenteXa:

Personal Information:
- Full name, email address, phone number
- Delivery address and location
- National ID number (for agents and super agents only)

Transaction Information:
- Orders placed, products purchased, payment amounts
- Invoice numbers and transaction references
- Parcel tracking history

Technical Information:
- Device type, browser, IP address
- Pages visited, time spent on platform
- Search queries and browsing history on KenteXa
privacy_policy.section2_content:
We use your information to:
- Process orders and facilitate transactions between buyers and sellers
- Send OTP verification codes and account notifications
- Generate invoices, receipts and tracking numbers
- Show you relevant products and listings
- Prevent fraud and ensure platform security
- Communicate important platform updates
- Improve our services through analytics
privacy_policy.section3_content:
We share your information only when necessary:

With Sellers: Your delivery address, name and phone number are shared with sellers to fulfill your order.

With Payment Processors: Your phone number is shared with M-Pesa, Airtel, Tigo or other payment providers to process payments.

With Delivery Agents: Your delivery address, name and phone are shared with Super Agents and local agents to deliver your parcel.

With Authorities: We may share information with law enforcement if required by Tanzanian law.

We do NOT sell your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy_policy.section4_content:
We protect your data using:
- Encrypted database storage
- Secure HTTPS connections for all data transmission
- JWT token-based authentication
- Password hashing (bcrypt) — we never store plain passwords
- Regular security audits

No system is 100% secure. In the event of a data breach, we will notify affected users within 72 hours.
privacy_policy.section5_content:
KenteXa uses:
- Local storage to keep you logged in between sessions
- Session data to maintain your cart
- Basic analytics to understand how users navigate the platform

We do not use third-party advertising trackers or sell browsing data to advertisers.
privacy_policy.section6_content:
You have the right to:
- Access your personal data at any time via your Profile page
- Update or correct your information
- Request deletion of your account and data
- Withdraw consent for marketing communications

To exercise these rights, contact us at support@kentexa.com
privacy_policy.section7_content:
We retain your data for as long as your account is active. After account deletion:
- Transaction records are kept for 7 years (legal requirement)
- Personal profile data is deleted within 30 days
- Parcel tracking records are kept for 2 years
privacy_policy.section8_content: KenteXa is not intended for users under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If we discover a minor has created an account, we will delete it immediately.
privacy_policy.section9_content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or platform notification. Your continued use of KenteXa after changes constitutes acceptance.
privacy_policy.section10_content:
For privacy-related questions or to exercise your data rights:

📧 Email: support@kentexa.com
🌐 Website: kentexa.com
🏢 Company: Bishoo Intelligence Systems (BiS), Tanzania
